title: Route C — each club's official-site depth-chart page, probed for all 32 clubs
method: One fetch per club depth-chart URL pattern https://www.<club-host>/team/depth-chart, where every club-host is copied from the league's own 'View Full Site' link on https://www.nfl.com/teams/ (read 2026-11-17). Fields record what the page printed; slot counts are transcribed row counts of the rendered tables (GB includes one printed continuation row); aggregates are computed at build time, never typed. Unconfirmable fields are blank.
